user_prompt: We're launching a new product line next quarter and need to orchestrate the entire go-to-market process—including provisioning our key customers, qualifying our supplier network, analyzing the cost structure, managing our engineering modifications, and ensuring our teams are ready. As part of this, we also need to identify which customer segments from our marketing campaigns should be prioritized for this launch, including pulling their account details and engagement history. We'll also need to assess whether our current staff has the right skills and capacity to support the new product specifications and training requirements. Can you help us coordinate all these moving pieces into one comprehensive launch workflow?
